decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, as set out in the attached schedule which forms part of this notice. Location Plan,Location and Block Plan LD25 J195 002PP Rev0 15.04.2025,Existing Plans & Pre-construction info LD25 J195 001 Ref: 03 17.03.2025,Plans Proposal LD25 J195 003PP Rev0 15.04.2015,Flood map for planning 12.08.2025SuDS Pro Forma,SuDS Rain Planter and Water Butt LD25 J195 004PP Rev0 15.04.2025Planning Statement 11.11.2025Considerations on the potential impact on sunlight/daylight 08.12.2025Sunlight & Daylight Assessments Impact Assessment 30.01.2026Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external finishes shall be in materials to match those of the exterior of the existing buildings unless otherwise agreed by the Local Planning Authority in writing.  Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

The first floor side windows shall be obscure glazed, and all new external finishes shall be in materials to match those of the exterior of the existing building.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.
description: Part single/part two storey side and rear extensions, front porch and conversion of loft into habitable space.
